st-dl-dist-east-delhi.name: East Delhi
st-dl-dist-east-delhi.description: District of Delhi (NCT) (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Preet Vihar. Population approximately 1,709,346 (2011 census), area approximately 440 km2.

st-dl-dist-new-delhi.name: New Delhi
st-dl-dist-new-delhi.description: District of Delhi (NCT) (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Connaught Place. Population approximately 142,004 (2011 census), area approximately 22 km2.

st-dl-dist-north-delhi.name: North Delhi
st-dl-dist-north-delhi.description: District of Delhi (NCT) (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Sadar Bazaar. Population approximately 887,978 (2011 census), area approximately 59 km2.

st-dl-dist-north-east-delhi.name: North East Delhi
st-dl-dist-north-east-delhi.description: District of Delhi (NCT) (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Seelampur. Population approximately 2,241,624 (2011 census), area approximately 52 km2.

st-dl-dist-north-west-delhi.name: North West Delhi
st-dl-dist-north-west-delhi.description: District of Delhi (NCT) (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Kanjhawala. Population approximately 3,656,539 (2011 census), area approximately 130 km2.

st-dl-dist-shahdara.name: Shahdara
st-dl-dist-shahdara.description: District of Delhi (NCT) (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Nand Nagri. Population approximately 322,931 (2011 census), area approximately 60 km2.

st-dl-dist-south-delhi.name: South Delhi
st-dl-dist-south-delhi.description: District of Delhi (NCT) (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Saket. Population approximately 2,731,929 (2011 census), area approximately 250 km2.

st-dl-dist-south-east-delhi.name: South East Delhi
st-dl-dist-south-east-delhi.description: District of Delhi (NCT) (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Defence Colony. Population approximately 1,500,636 (2011 census), area approximately 102 km2.

st-dl-dist-south-west-delhi.name: South West Delhi
st-dl-dist-south-west-delhi.description: District of Delhi (NCT) (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Vasant Vihar. Population approximately 2,292,958 (2011 census), area approximately 395 km2.

st-dl-dist-west-delhi.name: West Delhi
st-dl-dist-west-delhi.description: District of Delhi (NCT) (Union Territory), India, headquartered at Rajouri Garden. Population approximately 2,543,243 (2011 census), area approximately 112 km2.

st-dl-urban-local-bodies.name: Urban Local Bodies of Delhi (NCT)
st-dl-urban-local-bodies.description: The urban local self-government bodies of Delhi (NCT) (municipal corporations, municipalities/municipal councils and nagar/town panchayats), constituted under Part IXA of the Constitution.
st-dl-urban-local-bodies.legalBasis: Constitution of India, Part IXA (74th Amendment, 1992)
st-dl-urban-local-bodies.notes: Only the municipal-corporation count is directly sourced (Wikipedia 'List of municipal corporations in India', cross-validated against the national total of 273 on lgdirectory.gov.in's dashboard). Municipality/nagar-panchayat (municipal council / nagar panchayat) counts per state were not obtainable without the CAPTCHA-gated LGD per-state reports or an additional secondary source, and are left out rather than estimated.

st-dl-assembly.name: Delhi Legislative Assembly
st-dl-assembly.description: The unicameral 70-seat elected legislature of Delhi. The 8th Assembly was elected in February 2025; BJP holds 48 seats and AAP 22.
st-dl-assembly.head: st-dl-pos-speaker

st-dl-dept-general-administration.name: General Administration Department
st-dl-dept-general-administration.description: Handles Delhi government's internal administration, personnel, cadre management and coordination between departments.
st-dl-dept-general-administration.head: st-dl-pos-chief-minister

st-dl-dept-finance.name: Finance Department
st-dl-dept-finance.description: Prepares the Delhi budget, controls government expenditure and manages the NCT's accounts and treasury.
st-dl-dept-finance.head: st-dl-pos-chief-minister

st-dl-dept-planning.name: Planning Department
st-dl-dept-planning.description: Prepares Delhi's five-year and annual plans, coordinates scheme outlays across departments and compiles socio-economic statistics.
st-dl-dept-planning.head: st-dl-pos-chief-minister

st-dl-dept-revenue.name: Revenue Department
st-dl-dept-revenue.description: Administers land revenue records, district administration (Deputy Commissioners/SDMs), land acquisition and disaster relief certification.
st-dl-dept-revenue.head: st-dl-pos-chief-minister

st-dl-dept-women-and-child-development.name: Department of Women and Child Development
st-dl-dept-women-and-child-development.description: Runs women's welfare, child protection and nutrition schemes (anganwadis, ICDS) for the NCT.
st-dl-dept-women-and-child-development.head: st-dl-pos-chief-minister

st-dl-dept-land-and-building.name: Land and Building Department
st-dl-dept-land-and-building.description: Manages allotment, lease and conversion of government land and built government properties in Delhi.
st-dl-dept-land-and-building.head: st-dl-pos-chief-minister

st-dl-dept-services.name: Services Department
st-dl-dept-services.description: Handles postings, transfers and service matters of DANICS/DASS and other Delhi government cadre officials.
st-dl-dept-services.head: st-dl-pos-chief-minister

st-dl-dept-information-and-publicity.name: Directorate of Information and Publicity
st-dl-dept-information-and-publicity.description: Publicises Delhi government schemes and policies to citizens and manages government advertising.
st-dl-dept-information-and-publicity.head: st-dl-pos-chief-minister

st-dl-dept-vigilance.name: Vigilance Department
st-dl-dept-vigilance.description: Examines complaints of corruption and irregularities against Delhi government officials and processes disciplinary references.
st-dl-dept-vigilance.head: st-dl-pos-chief-minister

st-dl-dept-administrative-reforms.name: Administrative Reforms Department
st-dl-dept-administrative-reforms.description: Drives e-governance, service-delivery reform and citizen charter/right-to-service implementation across Delhi government departments.
st-dl-dept-administrative-reforms.head: st-dl-pos-chief-minister

st-dl-dept-public-works.name: Public Works Department
st-dl-dept-public-works.description: Builds and maintains Delhi's government roads, flyovers, bridges and government buildings.
st-dl-dept-public-works.head: st-dl-pos-minister-1

st-dl-dept-law-justice-and-legislative-a.name: Department of Law, Justice and Legislative Affairs
st-dl-dept-law-justice-and-legislative-a.description: Provides legal advice to the Delhi government, handles litigation and drafts/vets legislation and rules including business before the Assembly. Note: the Feb 2025 portfolio order lists "Legislative Affairs" separately under Parvesh Verma while "Law & Justice" is under Kapil Mishra, even though both sit within this one notified department; headPositionId here follows the "Law & Justice" allocation.
st-dl-dept-law-justice-and-legislative-a.head: st-dl-pos-minister-5

st-dl-dept-gurdwara-elections.name: Directorate of Gurdwara Elections
st-dl-dept-gurdwara-elections.description: Conducts elections to the Delhi Sikh Gurdwara Management Committee under the Delhi Sikh Gurdwaras Act.
st-dl-dept-gurdwara-elections.head: st-dl-pos-minister-1

st-dl-dept-irrigation-and-flood-control.name: Irrigation and Flood Control Department
st-dl-dept-irrigation-and-flood-control.description: Maintains the Yamuna flood embankments, drains and irrigation channels and runs Delhi's flood control operations.
st-dl-dept-irrigation-and-flood-control.head: st-dl-pos-minister-1

st-dl-dept-water.name: Water Department
st-dl-dept-water.description: Administrative department overseeing water-supply and sewerage policy for Delhi, under which the statutory Delhi Jal Board operates.
st-dl-dept-water.head: st-dl-pos-minister-1

st-dl-dept-home.name: Home Department
st-dl-dept-home.description: Handles jails, home guards, civil defence and other internal-security-adjacent administrative matters; day-to-day policing in Delhi is controlled by the Lieutenant Governor/MHA through the Delhi Police Commissioner, not this department, under Article 239AA(3)(a).
st-dl-dept-home.head: st-dl-pos-minister-2

st-dl-dept-power.name: Power Department
st-dl-dept-power.description: Regulates Delhi's privatised power distribution companies (BSES, Tata Power-DDL) and administers electricity subsidy schemes.
st-dl-dept-power.head: st-dl-pos-minister-2

st-dl-dept-education.name: Directorate of Education
st-dl-dept-education.description: Runs Delhi government schools and regulates recognised private schools up to Class XII.
st-dl-dept-education.head: st-dl-pos-minister-2

st-dl-dept-higher-education.name: Department of Higher Education
st-dl-dept-higher-education.description: Oversees Delhi government/aided colleges and the state universities under the NCT (e.g. Delhi Skill and Entrepreneurship University administration lies elsewhere).
st-dl-dept-higher-education.head: st-dl-pos-minister-2

st-dl-dept-training-and-technical-educat.name: Department of Training and Technical Education
st-dl-dept-training-and-technical-educat.description: Runs ITIs, polytechnics and skill-development/technical-education programmes in Delhi.
st-dl-dept-training-and-technical-educat.head: st-dl-pos-minister-2

st-dl-dept-food-and-supplies.name: Department of Food, Supplies and Consumer Affairs
st-dl-dept-food-and-supplies.description: Administers the public distribution system (ration cards, fair price shops) and consumer-protection matters in Delhi.
st-dl-dept-food-and-supplies.head: st-dl-pos-minister-3

st-dl-dept-forests-and-wildlife.name: Department of Forests and Wildlife
st-dl-dept-forests-and-wildlife.description: Protects Delhi's forest cover, ridge area and wildlife, and enforces forest and wildlife protection laws.
st-dl-dept-forests-and-wildlife.head: st-dl-pos-minister-3

st-dl-dept-environment.name: Department of Environment
st-dl-dept-environment.description: Coordinates Delhi's air/water pollution control and climate action policy, working with the Delhi Pollution Control Committee.
st-dl-dept-environment.head: st-dl-pos-minister-3

st-dl-dept-industries.name: Department of Industries
st-dl-dept-industries.description: Regulates industrial areas, MSME registration and industrial policy in Delhi.
st-dl-dept-industries.head: st-dl-pos-minister-3

st-dl-dept-social-welfare.name: Department of Social Welfare
st-dl-dept-social-welfare.description: Runs old-age, disability and other welfare pensions and homes/shelters for the destitute in Delhi.
st-dl-dept-social-welfare.head: st-dl-pos-minister-4

st-dl-dept-sc-st-welfare.name: Department of Welfare of SC/ST/OBC and Minorities
st-dl-dept-sc-st-welfare.description: Implements scholarships, hostels and welfare schemes for Scheduled Castes, Scheduled Tribes, OBCs and minorities in Delhi.
st-dl-dept-sc-st-welfare.head: st-dl-pos-minister-4

st-dl-dept-cooperative.name: Cooperative Department
st-dl-dept-cooperative.description: Registers and regulates cooperative societies, including group housing and consumer cooperatives, in Delhi.
st-dl-dept-cooperative.head: st-dl-pos-minister-4

st-dl-dept-elections.name: Elections Department
st-dl-dept-elections.description: Coordinates the Delhi government's administrative role in electoral matters distinct from the CEO Delhi's Election Commission of India functions.
st-dl-dept-elections.head: st-dl-pos-minister-4

st-dl-dept-labour.name: Labour Department
st-dl-dept-labour.description: Enforces labour laws, registers establishments/construction workers and runs the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.
st-dl-dept-labour.head: st-dl-pos-minister-5

st-dl-dept-employment.name: Directorate of Employment
st-dl-dept-employment.description: Runs employment exchanges and job-placement/career-counselling services for Delhi.
st-dl-dept-employment.head: st-dl-pos-minister-5

st-dl-dept-development.name: Development Department
st-dl-dept-development.description: Looks after rural/village-level development works in Delhi's rural areas and panchayats.
st-dl-dept-development.head: st-dl-pos-minister-5

st-dl-dept-art-culture-and-language.name: Department of Art, Culture and Language
st-dl-dept-art-culture-and-language.description: Promotes Delhi's art, culture, heritage and Urdu/Punjabi/Sanskrit language academies.
st-dl-dept-art-culture-and-language.head: st-dl-pos-minister-5

st-dl-dept-tourism.name: Tourism Department
st-dl-dept-tourism.description: Promotes Delhi as a tourist destination and runs Delhi Tourism and Transportation Development Corporation oversight.
st-dl-dept-tourism.head: st-dl-pos-minister-5

st-dl-dept-health-and-family-welfare.name: Department of Health and Family Welfare
st-dl-dept-health-and-family-welfare.description: Runs Delhi government hospitals, dispensaries and public-health/family-welfare programmes.
st-dl-dept-health-and-family-welfare.head: st-dl-pos-minister-6

st-dl-dept-transport.name: Transport Department
st-dl-dept-transport.description: Regulates public and private transport, vehicle registration/licensing and bus operations (DTC) in Delhi.
st-dl-dept-transport.head: st-dl-pos-minister-6

st-dl-dept-information-technology.name: Information Technology Department
st-dl-dept-information-technology.description: Drives Delhi government's e-governance platforms, digital service delivery and IT infrastructure.
st-dl-dept-information-technology.head: st-dl-pos-minister-6

st-dl-council-of-ministers.name: Delhi Council of Ministers
st-dl-council-of-ministers.description: The Chief Minister and cabinet ministers of Delhi, collectively responsible to the Delhi Legislative Assembly, currently 7-member (CM + 6 ministers) under the Rekha Gupta ministry sworn in 20 February 2025.
st-dl-council-of-ministers.head: st-dl-pos-chief-minister

st-dl-mc-delhi.name: Municipal Corporation of Delhi
st-dl-mc-delhi.description: The unified municipal corporation covering most of Delhi (re-unified in 2022 from three prior corporations), providing civic services such as sanitation, primary education and local roads. 250 elected wards + 10 nominated members.
st-dl-mc-delhi.head: st-dl-pos-mayor-mcd

st-dl-mc-new-delhi.name: New Delhi Municipal Council
st-dl-mc-new-delhi.description: Civic body for the Lutyens' New Delhi area (government/diplomatic core); unlike MCD it is a nominated body, not elected — chairperson and most members appointed by the Union Government, with the Delhi CM and some MLAs/MPs as ex-officio members.
st-dl-mc-new-delhi.head: st-dl-pos-chairperson-ndmc

st-dl-sec.name: State Election Commission, Delhi
st-dl-sec.description: Constitutional authority under Article 243ZA/GNCTD Act responsible for conducting elections to the Municipal Corporation of Delhi.
st-dl-sec.head: st-dl-pos-sec-commissioner

st-dl-lokayukta.name: Lokayukta of Delhi
st-dl-lokayukta.description: Anti-corruption ombudsman for Delhi government functionaries. The post has been vacant since the last Lokayukta's term ended around 2020.
st-dl-lokayukta.head: st-dl-pos-lokayukta

st-dl-electorate.name: People of Delhi
st-dl-electorate.description: The residents and voters of Delhi, a Union Territory administered by the Union government.
